component.name: QCADesigner-E
component.summary: Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) circuit designer and simulator

description.p: QCADesigner-E is an extension of QCADesigner (version 2.0.3) developed at the University of Bremen. It implements the estimation of the power dissipation of Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) circuits based on the works of Timler and Lent et al.

The extension is integrated as an additional simulation module based on the Coherence Vector Simulation Engine (CVSE). QCADesigner-E is fully compatible with QCA designs generated with QCADesigner version 2.0.3.

ul.li: Interactive schematic design and layout of QCA circuits
Energy dissipation and power estimation using CVSE
Bistable and Coherence Vector simulation engines
Multi-layer support, clock zone assignment, and customizable cell properties
